policy_note.String: VersionedProjectPolicy: require verified victory and the mode-owned domain binding; never infer a domain from enemy stage flags or the generic Encounter decision kind. The production DomainChoices policy enables positive Elite/Aberration contexts through authenticated public choices; original room placement and enemy programs remain pending.

policy_note.String: VersionedProjectPolicy: require a verified victory and the active current holding with positive domain allowance. Admit all current mode-owned battle-domain labels, including Combat/Elite/Aberration/Boss; labels do not establish original room topology. Apply the same active suppression states as ordinary post-battle Blessings; do not apply sealing-wax offer weights. Empty pools grant/draw nothing. Commit holdings and Equation refresh before ordinary offer generation with verified carry, later stages and all RNG in one rollback boundary. Loss/fault/rejected/duplicate results never grant. Battle settlement does not consume the domain allowance.
